results.description:
Notion is an AI-powered all-in-one workspace that helps individuals and teams write notes, manage tasks, organize projects, and collaborate in one place. Whether you’re tracking personal to-do lists, writing and organizing class notes, or managing projects with a team, Notion helps users plan work, stay organized, and achieve goals.

"AI's everything app" — Forbes

Notion is a productivity app where you can write, plan, and organize your notes, projects, tasks and more. Ask Notion AI about project updates, upcoming tasks, and suggestions for a more streamlined workflow.

Simplify writing notes, project and task management, and collaboration. Whether for personal, student or professional use, Notion scales to meet your individual needs with customization tools for everyone.

NEW features:
• AI Meeting Notes: Perfect meeting memory. Your notetaker catches every detail and delivers actionable summaries, right where you work.
• Maps View: Turn databases into interactive maps. Use the new Place property to pin restaurants, trips, offices, clients, and more.

FREE FOR PERSONAL USE
Individuals manage day-to-day tasks, notes, and personal organization.
• Create as many notes, docs, and content as you want.
• Use one of thousands of templates to get started.

FREE TO TRY WITH YOUR TEAM
Teams run on Notion every day, from next-generation startups to established enterprises.
• Import Google Docs, PDFs, and other content types easily to get started
• Write and organize meeting notes, or transcribe with AI.
• Collaboration and team work at your fingertips, in one connected workspace.
• Connect tools like Figma, Slack, and GitHub to Notion.

FREE FOR STUDENTS
Students organize notes, assignments, and study plans in one place.
• Your study planner, class notes, to do lists and more, your way. Loved by millions of students worldwide.
• Get organized for your best school year yet with beautiful, customizable templates created by students, for students.

NOTES & DOCS
Communication is made efficient with Notion's flexible building blocks.
• Create docs with beautiful templates, images, to-dos, and 50+ more content types.
• Meeting notes, projects, design systems, pitch decks, and more.
• Find exactly what you need using Search with powerful filters to find content across your workspace.

TASKS & PROJECTS
Catch all details big and small in any workflow.
• Workflow manager: Create your own priority labels, status tags, and automations to choose the exact info you want to track.
• Capture every detail in a table. Break projects into manageable tasks to get the work done.

AI
One tool that does it all - search, generate, analyze, and chat - right inside Notion.
• Create notes. Transcribe meeting notes with AI.
• Turn databases into interactive maps. Use the new Place property to pin restaurants, trips, offices, clients, and more.
• Write better. Use Notion AI to help write and brainstorm.
• Get answers. Ask Notion AI questions about all your content and get answers in seconds.
• Autofill tables. Notion AI turns overwhelming data into clear, actionable information  — automatically.

SYNCS WITH BROWSER, MAC, AND WINDOWS APPS.
• Pick up on mobile where you left off on desktop.

MORE PRODUCTIVITY. FEWER TOOLS.
• Track to-dos, write notes, create docs, and manage projects in one connected workspace.

THINK IT. MAKE IT.

Notion Calendar lets you schedule meetings and control your time like never before. It deeply integrates with Google Calendar accounts so that all your events are synced.

Along with speed, beauty, and light/dark modes, Notion Calendar includes powerful features:

- CONNECTED TO NOTION — add Notion docs, projects, and timelines.
- MULTIPLE TIME ZONES — pull the time zone column to the right to “travel to any city” and add more time zones.
- ALL IN ONE PLACE — see one unified view across multiple calendars and auto-sync events between them.
- WIDGETS — select from 6 Home Screen Widgets featuring rich previews of upcoming events, month overviews, quick-add event buttons, and more! The Lock Screen Widget lets you see what’s coming at a glance when picking up your phone.
- AVAILABLE IN 12 LANGUAGES — Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Norwegian, and Swedish.

It’s time.

title.label: The iPad App is basically view-only

content.label: I will start by saying I love Notion. I use it to organize both my work and personal lives. For work, I primarily access Notion using my desktop computer. However, for my personal life, my main device is an iPad Pro with Magic Keyboard. The Notion app on iPad lacks so many features (calendar, etc) or glitches (moves the screen down when trying to type, so you cannot see the text as you type it) as to make it almost impossible to edit or create pages on an iPad. It is essentially a view-only system for existing content. Extremely disappointing given how much success I have had using Notion in my professional life - I was hoping to replicate that in my personal life, but that would involve the iPad app working…
Doesn’t work at all

title.label: Finally found a system that works with my brain

content.label:
I’ve tried a lot of productivity and organization apps over the years, but Notion is the first one that actually feels flexible enough to grow with how I think instead of forcing me into someone else’s system.

I originally started using it for notes and organization, but it quickly became a place where I could connect ideas, workflows, AI concepts, healthcare operations, and long-term planning in a way that feels natural and visual.

What I appreciate most is that it works for both structured thinking and creative thinking at the same time. I can build detailed workflow maps one minute and brainstorm future ideas the next without switching platforms.

As someone working in healthcare operations and AI workflow design, I also love how adaptable it is for building living systems instead of static documents.

It genuinely helped me feel more organized, focused, and excited about my ideas again.

Later maybe newb users like me would switch off easy mode and use the whole thing.  But dang it would be nice for when you have are just switching over to get started.   I downloaded a 3rd party app just to have a normal todo list.  
And yes. I know you have a long list of how to learn to use your system check boxes.  But sheesh, hard to carve out time in the middle of a normal work week.  

Just a suggestion from us more simple folk.  Ha!   

Oh and a quick note/todo add widget would be nice. 

Thank you for your time.

title.label: Everything is super, but mobile version…

content.label:
I really love Notion and have been using it for several years. But please, developers, do something about the mobile version.

Every time I spend a while inside a note working with text, after about 10–15 minutes, Notion stops responding to taps, doesn’t allow editing, and I have to close the app and reopen it.

This reduces productivity and is very inconvenient. I don’t experience this issue in other apps where I work with text, so the problem isn’t my iPhone.

Thank you!

Had to delete because of the AI. Obviously AI is not only terrible for the environment (uses so much water without recycling it) and contributes to cognitive decline (our brains need to stretch and work doing even “simple” things to build and maintain key neural pathways), it’s also a massive security risk AND the generative aspect of it straight up just doesn’t work, like you end up typing like four or five prompts in and faffing about refining the result that it would have taken less time just to write whatever you were trying to make the AI write. As much as I hate AI, I really really loved Notion and I would have kept it if they’d have some option for toggling off the AI features. They’re just really obtrusive and obnoxious for how useless/harmful they are, like I don’t want an AI assistant helping me write and stealing my content. But rather than remove or add an off-switch, the developers just kept cramming more AI slop in there, so I’ve had to delete it. It’s such a crying shame. I recalled loved Notion. I’d come back in a heartbeat if they ditched the AI slop.

title.label: Useless if you plan on using voice to text

content.label:
The voice to text functionality of the app continually degrades overtime. It simply cannot function for taking notes in this method as it will do a terrible job at detecting the proper words, that is if you get to keep the words after you are done with your prompt. You will literally see the words be removed when you are finished right in front of your eyes. 

This is nothing new, and has been common for a little over two years, and I have simply stopped using Notion on my devices because it may be a powerful tool, but for brainstorming it is completely useless when trying to use voice to text.
